announcements.headline: THEON moves to completes MERIO acquisition following receipt of required approvals; new orders already awarded
announcements.insight: Theon completes its acquisition of HGH Systèmes Infrarouges following earlier exclusivity. New orders support this strategic expansion.

announcements.headline: THEON awarded Night Vision contracts worth c.€45 million from two European NATO member states
announcements.insight: THEON secured €45m in contracts following its June order acceleration. This reinforces the growth trajectory highlighted in recent updates.

announcements.headline: THEON announces Q2 2026 / H1 2026 Trading Update
announcements.insight: THEON provides a trading update following recent order wins and an exclusivity agreement for HGH Systèmes Infrarouges. Shareholders should watch for details on how these developments impact financial performance.

announcements.headline: THEON receives new orders of c.€70 million and continues acceleration on all fronts
announcements.insight: New orders follow June announcements of secured contracts and an exclusivity agreement for HGH Systèmes Infrarouges acquisition. This indicates continued commercial momentum alongside strategic expansion.

announcements.headline: THEON Enters into Exclusivity Agreement for the Acquisition of HGH Systèmes Infrarouges, Accelerating Expansion into Multi-Domain ISR & Counter-UAS Solutions
announcements.insight: THEON enters an exclusivity agreement for a new acquisition, following its recent SAFRAN partnership. This signals continued expansion into multi-domain ISR and counter-UAS solutions.

announcements.headline: SAFRAN and THEON partner to fast-track fielding of electro-optical solutions for drones
announcements.insight: THEON partners with SAFRAN to fast-track drone electro-optical solutions. This follows recent order wins and AGM results, indicating continued commercial momentum.

announcements.headline: Result of Annual General Meeting 2026 (AGM) and Declaration of Dividend for Financial Year 2025
announcements.insight: Shareholders receive AGM results and a FY2025 dividend declaration. This follows the June 2026 order win, confirming governance completion.

announcements.headline: THEON secures c.€42 million in new orders; additional c.€27 million in options
announcements.insight: New orders boost revenue visibility. Options provide future upside potential for shareholders.
